title: Run Library
description:
[h2]Run Library[/h2]
A small host-side companion mod for the free [b]STS2 Save Sync[/b] app.

When you pick a co-op run from your save library in STS2 Save Sync and click its Host link, the app loads that run into your multiplayer save slot and launches the game. With Run Library installed, the game then opens straight into that run's Load lobby instead of stopping at the main menu, so your friends can join right away.

[h3]Requirements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The free STS2 Save Sync companion app (Microsoft Store, or see [url=https://sts2.thegates.house]sts2.thegates.house[/url])
[*] Access to a save library in that app
[/list]
Without the app the mod does nothing.

[h3]How it works[/h3]
The app leaves a one-time note on your computer before launching the game. On the main menu the mod reads the note, deletes it, and opens Multiplayer > Load only if everything matches: the note is recent, your Steam account, regular/modded mode and active profile are the ones the app used, and your multiplayer save is the same run. Otherwise nothing happens and you stay on the main menu. It uses the game's own Load flow, with all its normal checks and screens.

[h3]Safe and private[/h3]
[list]
[*] Never goes online: it only reads the local note the app writes
[*] Never writes or changes your saves
[*] Host-only: your friends don't need it
[/list]

Built for game version v0.107.1. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Mega Crit.

Source code and issues: [url=https://github.com/brian-gates/sts2-run-library]github.com/brian-gates/sts2-run-library[/url]
